# Gramlot 0.3.18

- Define explicit surface/text and header/text pairs for each theme in light and dark mode; improve contrast without automatic color inversion.
- Apply the header colors consistently to dialog, floating and Labelbox cards, with compact tray titles and a consistent drag cursor across the whole title.
- Reorganize the public learning path and shared widget reference; clarify initial Data, collections, HTML tags and reusable components.
- Keep dbSelect and dbComboBox documented as quarantined prototypes pending a complete legacy API review.
